minor.issue: Code comment claims FastAPI FileResponse 'handles HTTP Range requests automatically', but observed behavior is 200 + full body even when Range header is sent. Accept-Ranges: bytes is advertised but no 206 partial-content responses are emitted. Modern Chromium/Safari still play because they request full file; iOS Safari mobile may scrub-seek inefficiently. Recommend adding starlette.responses.Response with explicit Range parsing OR using a streaming endpoint that returns 206 with Content-Range when a Range header is present.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/posts.py:74-83 — create_post empty-check ANDs together the absence of content with the absence of EVERY media field. This is correct, but the chained `and not` reads awkwardly; consider a single helper `has_any_media(payload)` for clarity and to prevent future fields being missed (e.g., a future `gif_url` would silently fall through).

backend/routers/posts.py:107-112 — sound_* fields are flat on the post doc. Consider grouping under a `sound: { track_id, url, title, cover_url, duration }` sub-doc for future schema cleanliness, but flat is fine for now.
backend/routers/sounds.py:196-209 — comment says FileResponse handles Range automatically; it does not in this starlette version. Either upgrade starlette or implement Range manually.
backend/services/audio_store.py:211 — filename regex `^[a-f0-9]{32}\.(mp3|m4a|aac|wav|ogg|flac|webm)$` correctly prevents path traversal. Good.

rca of the issue: No P0/P1 issues found. P2: /api/sounds/file/{name} does not honor HTTP Range headers (returns 200 + full body even when Range header is sent). Root cause: FastAPI FileResponse on the current starlette version does not implement Range — the code comment is incorrect. Mitigation: implement explicit Range parsing in routers/sounds.py:serve() to return 206 Partial Content with Content-Range header, OR upgrade starlette to a version that supports Range in FileResponse. Impact is minor for desktop Chrome/Firefox (they still play the full body) but suboptimal for iOS Safari scrub-seek which expects 206. P3: create-image-picker-pick-device testid missing on the CHOOSE IMAGE button in ImageUploadPicker.jsx — purely a testability gap, does not affect user flow.
